tasks.label: KOPRUQ → GitHub
args: git add .; if (git status --porcelain) { $branch = git branch --show-current; $date = Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm'; git commit -m ('KOPRUQ_backup_' + $date); if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { git push origin $branch; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) { Write-Host ''; Write-Host ('KOPRUQ successfully pushed to GitHub [' + $branch + ']') } } } else { Write-Host ''; Write-Host 'KOPRUQ: No new changes to push.' }
